_note: 2026-11-18: expected monthly salary on a seeker profile (programme ask: capture desired salary on the UP inbound line). Added to create_profile and update_profile on kkb-hi-in-signals: two optional number parameters, and item_state.salaryMin / salaryMax in the payload template (the seeker profile_1.0 schema has both as numbers).

salaryMin.description: Lowest monthly salary the caller expects, in rupees, as a number ("बारह हज़ार" -> 12000). One figure -> the same number in salaryMin and salaryMax. No figure given -> leave out; never 0.

salaryMax.description: Highest monthly salary the caller expects, in rupees, as a number. One figure -> same as salaryMin. No figure given -> leave out; never 0.
